the settled wave's verdict builder the refusing arm rides out on

summary: A mid-wave refill read that did not resolve reports nothing: one arm stops the wave pulling off every surface, the other throws bare past a settled wave whose spans are on trunk

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: both arms of a mid-wave queue re-read that did not resolve reach the tick's facts — the walled arm names the failure on `TickResult.queueParseFailure`, the field the opening read already reports through and whose own hover states the distinction it buys; the arm that refuses outright throws past the settled wave carrying the verdict its `mergeError` sibling already carries — so a chain's `handoff` tells a queue that stopped resolving from one the wave drained, and a tick whose spans landed on trunk is never classified as a decide-read that refused before any agent ran
tests: a wave whose mid-wave queue re-read did not parse reports the parse failure on its result
a wave walled by a mid-wave queue re-read the phase cannot rewrite reports a verdict naming the spans it shipped
notes: Arm 1: `refillWalled` (`src/waveTick.ts:292`, set `:457`) leaves as a `log.warn`, read only by `wavePulls` (`:430`); `queueParseFailure` (`:701`) is the opening read's alone. Arm 2, off note THE-WAVES-TWO-VERDICT-PRODUCERS-NAME-ONE-FACT-SET: the hard refusal (`src/pendingLedger.ts:796`) lands in `slotError` (`:523`) and throws bare at `:538`, ahead of the `mergeError` sibling (`:546`) that carries a verdict, while `src/Dispatcher.ts:955` calls it a read that refused before any agent ran.
